<includeonly>{{#if: {{{link|}}}
|
	{{#switch:1

	<!--
		protocols
	-->

	<!-- enfusion:// - must be above enfusionengine.com -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|enfusion://}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="enfusion">{{#ifeq:{{#sub:{{{link}}}|0|43}}|https://enfusionengine.com/api/redirect?to=<!-- do NOT use redirects, just raw links -->
			| {{#if: {{{text|}}} | [{{#replace:{{#sub:{{{link}}}|43}}| |_}} {{{text}}}] | [{{#replace:{{#sub:{{{link}}}|43}}| |_}} {{#explode:{{{link}}}|/|-1}}] }} -redirect link provided-{{TemplateCase||[[Category:Link template usage error]]}}
			| {{#if: {{{text|}}} | [{{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} {{{text}}}] | [{{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} {{#explode:{{{link}}}|/|-1}}] }}
		}}</span>

	<!-- armareforger:// -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|armareforger://}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="armar">{{#if: {{{text|}}} | [{{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} {{{text}}}] | [{{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} {{#explode:{{{link}}}|/|-1}}] }}</span>

	<!-- steam:// -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|steam://}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="steam">{{#if: {{{text|}}} | [{{{link}}} {{{text}}}] | {{{link}}} }}</span>

	<!--
		domains
	-->

	<!-- Bohemia Interactive -->
	<!-- must be below Enfusion in case of enfusionengine.com redirection -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|bistudio.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|bohemia.net}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|arma2.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|arma3.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|armareforger.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|arma4.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|armaplatform.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|enfusionengine.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|dayz.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|takeonthegame.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|silicagame.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|vigorgame.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="bohemia">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- web.archive.org -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|web.archive.org}}
		|1|0}}= <span title="web.archive.org backup">{{#if: {{{text|}}} | [{{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} {{{text}}}] | {{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} }} <sub style="font-size: .8em">(archive)</sub></span>

	<!-- Wikipedia / Wiktionary -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|wikipedia.org}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="wikipedia" title="{{#if:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|Read the '{{#replace:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|_|&nbsp;}}' Wikipedia article|Access Wikipedia}}">[{{{link}}} {{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|{{#if:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|{{#replace:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|_|&#32;}}|{{{link}}}}}}}]</span>
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|wiktionary.org}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="wikipedia" title="{{#if:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|Read the '{{#replace:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|_|&nbsp;}}' Wiktionary article|Access the Wiktionary}}">[{{{link}}} {{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|{{#if:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|{{#replace:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/wiki/|1}}|_|&#32;}}|{{{link}}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- Steam -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|steampowered.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|steamcommunity.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|steamgames.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|steamstatic.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="steam" title="{{#if:{{#pos:{{{link}}}|steamcommunity.com}}|Steam Community file|Steam link}}">[{{{link}}} {{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|{{#if:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/filedetails/|1}}|Steam File {{#replace:{{#explode:{{{link}}}|/filedetails/|1}}|?id=}}|{{{link}}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- GOG -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|gog.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="gog" title="GOG link">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- GitHub -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|github.com}}

	<!-- Discord -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|discord.gg}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|discord.com}}

	<!-- Facebook -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|facebook.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="facebook" title="Facebook link">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- Twitter / X -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|.x.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|/x.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|.twitter.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|/twitter.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="twitter-x" title="Twitter/X link">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- YouTube -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|youtu.be}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|youtube.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="youtube">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- ofp.info fallback -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ofp.gamepark.cz}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ofp.gamepark.eu}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ofp.gamezone.cz}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ofp.info}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ofpr.info/ofpd/}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ftp://ofpr.info}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ftp://ftp.ofpr.info}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|ftp://www.ofpr.info}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="ofp-faguss-link" title="Old link: {{{link}}}">[https://ofp-faguss.com/addonsearch.php?searchfor={{URLENCODE:{{{link}}}}} {{#if:{{{text|}}}|{{{text}}}|ofpr.info link}}]</span> <span class="ofp-faguss-info">link courtesy of<br>[https://ofp-faguss.com/ OFP-Faguss.com]</span>

	<!-- AAN Online fallback - Kudos to Karel for it -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|aan.moricky.com}}

	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|aan-online.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="aan-online" title="AAN Online article - courtesy of Karel Mořický">[{{#replace:{{#replace:{{{link}}}|www.aan-online.com|aan.moricky.com}}|aan-online.com|aan.moricky.com}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	<!-- drives -->
	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|drive.google.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="googledrive">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

	|{{#if:
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|onedrive.live.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|1drv.ms/}}
		|1|0}}= <span class="onedrive">[{{{link}}} {{{text|{{{link}}}}}}]</span>

		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|sprocketidea.com}}
		{{#pos:{{{link}}}|withsix.com}}
		|1|0}}= <span title="Old link: {{{link}}}">{{#if:{{{text|}}}|''{{{text}}}'' <sub style="font-size: .8em">(dead link)</sub>|''-dead link-''}}</span>

	<!-- default link -->
	<!--
		community.bistudio.com/wiki/
		community.bohemia.net/wiki/
		= add to [[:Category:Link template usage error]]

	|#default= {{#if: {{{text|}}} | [{{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} {{{text}}}] | {{#replace:{{{link}}}| |_}} }}{{#if:
